title: How to Request a Physical Patient Case File from Medical Records
content:
ARTICLE: How to Request a Physical Patient Case File from Medical Records (KA-008)
SYSTEM: MRD Archive
DEPARTMENT: Medical Records (MRD / HIM)
VERSION: 1.5
OVERVIEW: This comprehensive operating guide details how hospital personnel should interact with the MRD Archive module to execute how to request a physical patient case file from medical records safely and reliably.
STEPS:
Step 1: Open the MRD Archive client terminal on any networked SMCH workstation and log in with role credentials.
Step 2: Enter the patient's unique UHID or Case Number to load active records.
Step 3: Access the designated submenu corresponding to How to Request a Physical Patient Case File from Medical Records and verify current patient status.
Step 4: Input all required clinical or administrative parameters, ensuring mandatory fields are validated.
Step 5: Verify preview confirmation modal and click 'Submit' to persist changes to the database.
Step 6: Print barcode, acknowledgement chit, or receipt as required by hospital compliance.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Connection timeout: Verify LAN cable connection or contact IT Helpdesk.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Permission Denied: Ensure user account has the assigned role in staff master permissions.
Contact Medical Records (MRD / HIM) coordinator or IT Operations Support at Extension 1033 (Email: it@smch.in).
